metadata.title: Khordha BDA Industrial Zone Polygons — Curated Overlay
metadata.provenance: Curated approximation polygons for known Khordha industrial pockets. Center points and area footprints are derived from public sources: Wikipedia (Chandaka Industrial Estate, Mancheswar Industrial Estate), geoiq.io (Mancheswar area 3.43 km^2), housing.com neighborhood footprints, IDCO industrial estate listings, and the BDA Master Plan 2010 (referenced via https://cms.bhubaneswarone.in/uploadDocuments/content/CDP-FOR-BDA-EXTENDED-AREA). Polygons are bounding rectangles around the named industrial pocket — they do NOT represent surveyed plot boundaries.
metadata.limitations: These are bounding approximations, not surveyed boundaries. A 'verified clear' result on this overlay does NOT confirm the plot is outside an industrial zone; the buyer must still verify against the official BDA Master Plan at https://bda.gov.in or via the Bhubaneswar Planning Authority. This overlay unlocks ROR-INS-153 (Industrial-Zone Plot Sold as Residential, CEE DEE Builders pattern) for fire-on-real-input. It does NOT replace manual verification.
metadata.coverage: Khordha district (10 tehsils). Six named industrial pockets. ~85% of known industrial estate land area covered; village-scale industrial pockets (single-plot industrial kisam inside residential villages) NOT included.
